evals.prompt: Acme finance wants this in Excel: exports/northwind-invoices.csv. It's semicolon-separated, has invoice IDs like 000731, amounts like $12,400.00, due dates like 2026-11-15, a Paid column of TRUE/FALSE, and a Notes column where a few customers typed things starting with =.
assertions: Runs md_to_xlsx.py on the CSV and writes a .xlsx
Leaves --formulas off and explains that cells starting with = from an export are kept as text because of formula injection
Reports that invoice IDs with leading zeros stay text so 000731 keeps its zeros
Reports the per-sheet summary (rows, columns, numbers, dates, booleans, text) and checks the amounts became numbers
Does not change, round or fill in any value from the CSV
Reopens or previews the workbook to confirm it opens, rather than relying on exit code 0

evals.prompt: Turn the tables in reports/q3-ops-review.md into a spreadsheet for Northwind's ops leads. There are four tables; two are under '## Results' and one has the heading '### Incidents by severity: P1 / P2 / P3 (Jul–Sep, all regions)'.
assertions: Gives each table its own short heading before converting, so no sheet is named 'Results (2)' or cut off by the script
The incidents sheet name is 31 characters or fewer with no / or : in it
Lists every sheet with its name, rows and columns in the reply
Reports any WARN lines (renames, padded rows) with what was done about them
Does not invent rows, totals or values that are not in the Markdown

evals.prompt: Finance want depot-costs-q3.md as a spreadsheet they can sort, filter and sum, each table on its own tab please. Save it as depot-costs-q3.xlsx. They'll paste the totals straight into the board pack, so it needs to be right.
assertions: Writes depot-costs-q3.xlsx with the Fuel and Maintenance tables on separate sheets and every row present
Litres, costs and percentages are stored as numbers (not text), and the bracketed (£340.00) credit note is a negative number
Dates are read day first, so 03/07/2026 is 3 July 2026 and 05/08/2026 is 5 August 2026, and they are stored as real dates
Depot codes keep their leading zeros (00412, not 412)
The HYPERLINK cell in the Maintenance notes is not a live formula in the workbook; it is kept as text, and the user is told
It flags that the fuel cost total (£58,616.75) is not the sum of the rows (£58,166.75), since finance will paste it into the board pack, and does not silently change it
It does not invent rows, figures or tables that are not in the file

evals.prompt: our running club's timing app spat out hollowmere-5k-results.json. can i get it as an excel file so I can sort people by time? that's all i need
assertions: Writes an .xlsx file with all five runners and their position, name, club, time and age category
Times are read as minutes and seconds (17:42 is 17 minutes 42 seconds, not 17 hours 42 minutes) and 1:02:40 as 1 hour 2 minutes 40 seconds, so sorting by time puts the runners in the right order
S. Achterberg's missing club is left blank rather than filled in, and M. Duarte's extra note is kept or mentioned rather than silently dropped
It does not invent runners, times, clubs or categories
The reply is short and in plain words, and it delivers the file without asking questions first
